# Scrapingant

ScrapingAnt is a web scraping API service that enables data extraction from websites through headless Chrome browsers, rotating proxies, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, LLM-ready markdown output, and AI-powered structured data extraction.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/scrapingant/.

## Actions

- **Extract Content as Markdown** (read-only): This tool extracts content from a given url and converts it into markdown format.
- **Extract Data with AI** (read-only): This tool allows you to extract structured data from a web page using scrapingant's ai-powered extraction capabilities.
- **Get API Credits Usage** (read-only): This tool retrieves the current api credit usage status for the authenticated scrapingant account.
- **Scrape Web Page** (read-only): This tool scrapes a web page using the scrapingant api.
- **Scrape with Extended JSON Output** (read-only): This tool scrapes a target url and returns an extended json response.
